domain(person,[vincent,hugh]).

% Vincent is trustworthy or has expertise.
axiom(s1,or(trustworthy(vincent),has_expertise(vincent))).

% Vincent examines evidence or thinks critically (or both).
axiom(s2,or(examines_evidence(vincent),thinks_critically(vincent))).

% Hugh examines evidence or thinks critically (or both).
axiom(s3,or(examines_evidence(hugh),thinks_critically(hugh))).

% If Vincent has expertise, then he works diligently and solves complex cases.
axiom(s4,rule([has_expertise(vincent)],and(works_diligently(vincent),solves_complex_cases(vincent)))).

% Vincent has keen insight.
axiom(s5,keen_insight(vincent)).

% Anyone who evaluates clues or makes connections can think critically.
axiom(s6,rule([or(evaluates_clues(X),makes_connections(X))],thinks_critically(X))).

% If someone has keen insight, then they analyze data and understand motives.
axiom(s7,rule([keen_insight(X)],and(analyzes_data(X),understands_motives(X)))).

% If Vincent follows clues, then he will uncover the truth.
axiom(s8,rule([follows_clues(vincent)],uncovers_truth(vincent))).

% If Vincent investigates crime, then he either examines evidence or analyzes data (but not both).
axiom(s9,rule([investigates_crime(vincent)],xor(examines_evidence(vincent),analyzes_data(vincent)))).

% Vincent investigates crime.
axiom(s10,investigates_crime(vincent)).

% If someone solves complex cases and thinks critically, then they can uncover the truth.
axiom(s11,rule([and(solves_complex_cases(X),thinks_critically(X))],uncovers_truth(X))).

% If Vincent either identifies patterns or connects clues (but not both), then he is able to analyze data.
axiom(s12,rule([xor(identifies_patterns(vincent),connects_clues(vincent))],able_to_analyze_data(vincent))).

% Vincent did not find justice.
axiom(s13,not(find_justice(vincent))).

% If someone uncovers the truth, then they can find justice.
axiom(s14,rule([uncovers_truth(X)],find_justice(X))).

% Vincent values integrity or is trustworthy.
axiom(s15,or(values_integrity(vincent),trustworthy(vincent))).

% If Vincent is reliable, then he either has expertise or has experience, but not both.
axiom(s16,rule([reliable(vincent)],xor(has_expertise(vincent),has_experience(vincent)))).
